clean_export.method: git archive of staged tracked files
clean_export.capture_cli: PASS_SCOPED_AVAILABLE_ENDPOINTS; 440 samples, 20 points; prior profiles byte-identical
clean_export.science_outputs: CSV and PNG byte-identical on fresh output directory

independent_ratios.method: Validated capture profiles, then independently recomputed rho_d*q sums over active-phase rows.

validation.log_regression: Exact manifest path/hash/size asserted; all 50 entries hash/size checked; restored log is not ignored.
validation.wrf_probe: Read-only review; historical executable hash pinned; no build or model run. No DWARF, ABI/rank ownership unresolved, source hashes do not prove compile inputs.
validation.graphify: Used for navigation; source and tests authoritative; graph freshness is not runtime or scientific validation.

scope_limits: Focused tests are not the full portable suite.
The archived equal-density sample comparison does not establish causality, forecast skill, historical concentration, or mass conservation.
No WRF rebuild, forecast, or first-microphysics capture was performed; RN1 timing/coverage, historical background-generation rules, C2 completion, and full water/energy budgets remain open.
